action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Apache Tika's ISA-Tab parser incorrectly handled
file path resolution. An attacker who could place files in a directory that
Tika subsequently parses could use this issue to read arbitrary files 
accessible to the Tika process and have their contents emitted into the 
extracted text output.
isummary:
Apache Tika could be made to expose sensitive information over the
network.
title: Apache Tika vulnerability
